_doctrine: 13-phase Wall Street cycle. Phase is JORDAN'S call (editorial). Until he calls it, phase='Awaiting Jordan's call' and phase_source='awaiting'. Score + trend are facts and always present; phase_suggestion is the auto/brain advisory. next_move is the FORWARD prediction (brain consensus) — where the phase goes next; current phase stays the anchor.

next_move.reasoning: Score sits in the Panic band (24-31) and with 0 of 65 recent 12h windows showing ±2+ point moves, this is a statistically confirmed coil — HOLD is the honest call until a visible breaker (volume spike, ETF flow reversal, or DXY breakdown) forces the hand, with Denial as the legal adjacent rung if sentiment stabilizes upward.
next_move.brains_agree: No — analyst calls HOLD with a Disbelief forward target (rule-violating distance), while narrative's bottom-divergence framing implies an UP leg; consensus splits the difference by holding position but acknowledging the bullish liquidity setup.
